WITH years_sequence AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 
    UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 
    UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, term_start, CAST(term_start AS DATE) AS term_start_date
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0 
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01' 
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_ends AS (
    SELECT 
        c.id_bioguide,
        c.term_start,
        c.term_start_date,
        n,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.term_start_date)::INTEGER + n - 1 AS check_year
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years_sequence n
),
still_in_office AS (
    SELECT 
        y.id_bioguide,
        y.check_year,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM legislators_terms lt 
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = y.id_bioguide 
              AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= DATE(y.check_year || '-12-31') 
              AND (lt.term_end IS NULL OR CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) > DATE(y.check_year || '-12-31'))
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS still_in_office
    FROM year_ends y
)
SELECT 
    check_year - MIN(check_year) OVER () AS year_offset,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(still_in_office) / COUNT(*), 4) AS retention_rate

WITH RECURSIVE years AS (
    SELECT 1 as year_num
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year_num + 1 FROM years WHERE year_num < 20
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id_bioguide, 
           CAST(SUBSTR(term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as start_year
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE term_number = 0
    AND term_start >= '1917-01-01'
    AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort_years AS (
    SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.start_year,
           y.year_num,
           ft.start_year + y.year_num - 1 as check_year
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN years y
),
check_dates AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, start_year, year_num, check_year,
           check_year - 1 as year_offset
    FROM cohort_years
),
check_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT check_year
    FROM check_dates
),
retention AS (
    SELECT ct.check_year,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ct.id_bioguide) as active_count
    FROM check_dates ct
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ct.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_start <= ct.check_year || '-12-31'
      AND lt.term_end >= ct.check_year || '-12-31'
    GROUP BY ct.check_year
)
SELECT cv.check_year, 
       CAST(r.active_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM first_terms) as retention_rate
FROM check_years cv
LEFT JOIN retention r ON cv.check_year = r.check_year
ORDER BY cv.check_year
